subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repo closing PR or ignore it and queue a fresh `openclaw/openclaw` fix for this WebUI `/model` subcommand bug?
rationale: The issue is still valid and narrow, but same-repo fix attempts are closed and the only open closing reference is a conflicting fork-repo PR, so automation should not silently create a competing fix without maintainer dedupe intent.

options.title: Queue a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Close or ignore the conflicting fork PR as non-canonical, then queue a narrow fix in `openclaw/openclaw` that follows current docs and shared command semantics.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to bring the fork PR into a current OpenClaw branch, resolve conflicts, revise semantics, and require fresh UI proof before merge.

options.title: Leave paired work open
options.body: Keep this issue open while waiting for the fork PR author to refresh their branch and provide proof, accepting that the reported bug remains unfixed meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Queue a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the conflicting fork PR as non-canonical, then queue a narrow fix in `openclaw/openclaw` that follows current docs and shared command semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits touched the model-command path and prior maintainer activity closed a stale sibling PR, making this the best available routing candidate.
